description: This file defines the interface and implementation for integrating libuv event loop with hiredis asynchronous Redis client, including event handling, timer management, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: redisLibuvPoll
methods.description: Handles polling events from libuv, calling appropriate redis async handlers based on event type.

methods.name: redisLibuvAddRead
methods.description: Enables read events on the libuv handle.

methods.name: redisLibuvDelRead
methods.description: Disables read events on the handle.

methods.name: redisLibuvAddWrite
methods.description: Enables write events on the handle.

methods.name: redisLibuvDelWrite
methods.description: Disables write events on the handle.

methods.name: on_timer_close
methods.description: Callback for closing the timer handle, frees resources if both timer and handle are closed.

methods.name: on_handle_close
methods.description: Callback for closing the handle, frees resources if both timer and handle are closed.

methods.name: redisLibuvTimeout
methods.description: Handles timer timeout, triggers redis async timeout handling.

methods.name: redisLibuvSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets or updates the timeout timer for redis operations.

methods.name: redisLibuvCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops timers, and closes handles.

methods.name: redisLibuvAttach
methods.description: Attaches redisAsyncContext to a libuv event loop, initializing event handlers and resources.
